lines.zh: 我一步一步走，结晶在肩上响。
lines.en: I walk step by step, crystals clicking at my shoulder.
I drag one ruined leg.
I can walk anywhere.
I come at you, not fast, but straight.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方留下黑痕。
lines.en: A dark track follows where I pass.
Half of my body is stone.
I snap the branches in my way.
I raise a hand, and the crystals move with it.

lines.zh: 我从沙漠走到草原，都一样。
lines.en: Desert or grassland, it's all the same to me.

lines.zh: 我走得不稳，但我不会停。
lines.en: My gait is uneven, but I don't stop.

lines.zh: 我朝有人的方向偏过去。
lines.en: I veer toward where people are.

lines.zh: 我的影子在裂缝里断了几截。
lines.en: My shadow breaks in pieces across the cracks.

lines.zh: 我站着，身上的结晶在长。
lines.en: I stand, and the crystals on me grow.

lines.zh: 我听见身体里有细小的碎裂声。
lines.en: I hear tiny cracking inside me.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，找什么，又忘了。
lines.en: I look up for something, then forget.
I press my shoulder; it's hard there.

lines.zh: 我呼吸很慢，像石头在喘。
lines.en: I breathe slow, like stone breathing.
I'm not waiting for a person.

lines.zh: 我数着自己的心跳，很闷。
lines.en: I count my heartbeats; they're muffled.
There's a glint in my eyes.
I stand, and the ground sinks with me.

lines.zh: 我记得自己以前有名字。
lines.en: I remember I once had a name.
The air around you is clean.

lines.zh: 你身上的铁味让我抬头。
lines.en: The iron on you lifts my head.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，那里有铁。
lines.en: I stare at your hand; there's iron in it.

lines.zh: 你手里的是什么？我看不清。
lines.en: What's in your hand? I can't see clearly.
I've walked the ground you stand on.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，指头已经不像手了。
lines.en: I raise a hand; the fingers aren't quite fingers.
I've been walking too long.
You stepped back; good.

lines.zh: 我的嘴唇动了一下，没出声。
lines.en: My lips move once, without sound.

lines.zh: 你身上有我丢掉的东西。
lines.en: You carry something I lost.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，肩膀上掉下碎晶。
lines.en: I step back, chips falling from my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我弯下腰，咳出一把碎晶。
lines.en: I double over and cough up a handful of crystal shards.
I press my chest; it's hard there.
Half a step slow, I catch up.

lines.zh: 我抖了一下，粉末落下来。
lines.en: I shudder, and powder falls.

lines.zh: 我不叫，叫出来的不像人声。
lines.en: I don't cry out; what comes out isn't human.
I lean on a tree, and its bark blackens.

lines.zh: 被打中的地方落下晶粉。
lines.en: Crystal dust falls from where I was struck.

lines.zh: 我把碎掉的一块按回去。
lines.en: I press a broken piece back in.

lines.zh: 我撑着地，没让自己跪下去。
lines.en: I brace against the ground and keep from dropping to my knees.
That iron; I can smell it.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西在发冷光。
lines.en: What you hold gives a cold light.
I reach toward you, slowly.
The crystals grow that way.
It wants that; I can't hold it back.
I smell originium.
Putting it away won't help.

lines.zh: 我的手臂上冒出新的晶。
lines.en: New crystal pushes out of my arm.
I stopped only because of it.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，会害了你。
lines.en: What you hold will hurt you.
You hit my shoulder; it's hard.

lines.zh: 我被撞了一下，结晶掉了一角。
lines.en: I take a hit, and a crystal corner breaks off.
I step back, and the ground cracks.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，自己退得更远。
lines.en: You crash in and go back further.

lines.zh: 我们碰在一起，你听见脆响。
lines.en: We collide, and you hear a brittle crack.
I reach to steady you; you flinch away.
My body is heavier than stone.

lines.zh: 你从我身边挤过去，我没拦。
lines.en: You squeeze past; I don't stop you.

lines.zh: 我被顶得歪了，慢慢正过来。
lines.en: I'm knocked askew and right myself.
Whoever hits me hurts their hand.

lines.zh: 另一个结晶的人站在那。
lines.en: Another crystallized figure stands there.
She says nothing, only looks at me.

lines.zh: 我们身上的晶颜色一样。
lines.en: Our crystals are the same color.

lines.zh: 我们一起走，脚步合不上。
lines.en: We walk together, our steps never matching.

lines.zh: 她把一块晶按进我手里。
lines.en: She presses a crystal into my hand.

lines.zh: 我们靠在一起，晶长到一起。
lines.en: We lean together, and the crystals join.
She's a little more whole than I am.
I remember how she used to look.

lines.zh: 我们之间只剩晶和沉默。
lines.en: Only crystal and silence between us.
We walk the same way.

lines.zh: 我拾起一块原石，握碎了。
lines.en: I pick up originium and crush it.

lines.zh: 我把你的剑捡起来，很轻。
lines.en: I pick up your sword; it's light.

lines.zh: 我抓起一把土，土变黑了。
lines.en: I scoop soil, and it blackens.
I pick up your dropped shield.

lines.zh: 我捡起一块结晶，含在手里。
lines.en: I pick up a crystal and hold it.

lines.zh: 我把地上的铁片收进身体。
lines.en: I take the iron scrap into my body.

lines.zh: 我拾起一具残骸，看了看。
lines.en: I pick up a wreck and study it.
I snap the fallen arrow.

lines.zh: 我捡起一枚瓶子，里面还有水。
lines.en: I pick up a bottle with water left.
I crush that stone to powder.
You carry what it wants.
I've raised my head; that's not good.
I come straight at you.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸传进我的骨头。
lines.en: Your breathing reaches my bones.
No need to run; I'm slow.

lines.zh: 我停住，把头慢慢转到你那边。
lines.en: I stop and slowly turn my head your way.
It chose for me: you.

lines.zh: 我的手臂抬起来，不是我想的。
lines.en: My arm rises, and it isn't my idea.

lines.zh: 你身上的东西，让我难受。
lines.en: What you carry makes me ache.

lines.zh: 我要在你靠近之前动手。
lines.en: I'll move before you get close.
I lower my shoulder, ready to charge.
This is the last thing I can do.
It's speaking inside my bones.
I count to three, then walk.
I've blocked that road.
I've seen you.
I grind forward inch by inch.
You go left; I turn slowly.
My shoulder hits a tree, and it breaks.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸带上碎石的响。
lines.en: My breath carries the sound of grit.
You back to the wall; I keep walking.
I hear you switch hands.

lines.zh: 我的脚陷进土里，拔出来。
lines.en: My foot sinks in soil and pulls free.
You circle; I circle, slower.

lines.zh: 我在等那一下，等它发力。
lines.en: I wait for it to surge.
My fingers spread, stiff.
Run; don't look back.
My shadow tracks you without moving.

lines.zh: 你把灯灭了，我反而看得清。
lines.en: You put the lamp out; I see better now.
Ten paces; not far.
I stop and take a breath.
It's loud inside my body.
I cave in a crack underfoot.

lines.zh: 你把东西丢下跑，我捡了。
lines.en: You dropped it and ran; I picked it up.
Step by step, I seal the road shut.
I slow my steps and let it move first.

lines.zh: 我一拳打过去，指节裂了。
lines.en: I throw a punch; a knuckle splits.
I ram you with my shoulder, heavy.

lines.zh: 我的手臂扫过去，带着晶。
lines.en: My arm sweeps, crystals and all.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的领子往下按。
lines.en: I take your collar and press down.
My knee meets your ribs.

lines.zh: 我抡起整条手臂砸下去。
lines.en: I swing my whole arm down like a hammer.
You blocked it, and your hands shake.
I catch your shield and bend it.
I shove you into the stone.

lines.zh: 结晶在我指间碎了一点。
lines.en: A little crystal crumbles between my fingers.
I step back, my arms hanging.
That one wasn't for me.
You pull back; I step forward again.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的脚，拖了一步。
lines.en: I catch your foot and drag once.

lines.zh: 我的力气比我以为的大。
lines.en: My strength is more than I thought.

lines.zh: 它满意了，我却不太清醒。
lines.en: It's satisfied, and I'm less awake.
I drive my shoulder through your shield.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的手臂，晶硌着你。
lines.en: I grip your arm, crystals digging in.
That punch goes wide and cracks the ground.
I drop my shoulder and ram.

lines.zh: 我从一片原石地里站起来。
lines.en: I stand up out of a field of originium.

lines.zh: 我的身体一半已经变了。
lines.en: Half my body has already changed.
I remember the pain of waking.
The air here hurts me.
I walked a long way to get here.
I stood motionless for a long while.
Stone is growing on me.
I saw you from far off.

lines.zh: 我从黑土里站起来，关节在响。
lines.en: I rise out of the black soil, joints creaking.

lines.zh: 地面在我脚下开始变黑。
lines.en: The ground blackens under me.

lines.zh: 我伸手，手已经不太像手。
lines.en: I reach out; the hand isn't quite a hand.

lines.zh: 我睁眼时，先看见的是原石。
lines.en: When I open my eyes, the first thing I see is originium.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的晶，裂缝往里走。
lines.en: Fire heats my crystals, and the cracks deepen.

lines.zh: 我摔下去，落地时碎了半边肩。
lines.en: I fall and shatter half a shoulder on landing.

lines.zh: 水进到裂缝里，冷得发疼。
lines.en: Water gets into the cracks, cold and sharp.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀翻，碎晶撒了一地。
lines.en: The blast flips me, crystal chips everywhere.
The arrow is stuck in crystal; it won't pull free.
A spell burns across my surface.

lines.zh: 我很久没找到能吞的东西。
lines.en: I haven't found anything to swallow in ages.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，晶全亮了。
lines.en: Lightning hits me, and every crystal lights.

lines.zh: 这里没有地，也没有原石。
lines.en: There's no ground here, and no originium.
